messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
I'll pull up that order now.

Thanks for the details, your order Shop···· is paid and the Bitfortun BS-4 plus the Harlo OS diagnostics pack haven't left yet.

It finished final testing at the manufacturer and was set to leave Monday, November 2, which is what we wrote to you on October 31. Tracking comes by email to (email hidden) as soon as the label is on the box, so it's worth whitelisting us so it doesn't land in spam.

Anything else I can check for you?
how long does that usually take?

Once it's picked up, the tracking email usually lands within a day, and the carrier's delivery estimate shows on that tracking page. I don't want to guess a transit time before the carrier sets one, so I'd rather not put a number on it than give you a wrong one.

If the tracking mail hasn't reached you by the end of this week, come back to me here and I'll chase it.
